entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF-77491. Just need to know if I can send it back.

Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up your order. One moment... Okay, I see the helmet was delivered six days ago. To start the process, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
It's the wrong color. Simple as that. The box is still unopened. I just need a return label.
I understand completely. I just need to confirm our policy. Since it's a helmet, we always have to be diligent about safety, but you mentioned the box is unopened, which is perfect.
Let me see... Yes, looking at the policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.
Great. So what's the next step?

I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file right now. You should receive it in the next minute or two. Just print it out and attach it to the package.
Okay, got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund. Is there anything else I can help with?
